summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #416, then switch to main and do a comprehensive documentation update: prune DEFERRED.md, update FEATURES.md and README.md, and create a new filesystem specification document.
summary.outcome: PR #416 review comments resolved (4 threads), committed, and pushed. Documentation PR #419 created on branch `docs/update-project-documentation` with all four documents updated/created, plus iterative cleanup of DEFERRED.md based on user feedback.

repo: Grafana Faro is the implemented error tracking solution (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts), not Sentry — session replay was never in scope as an anti-feature for a zero-knowledge privacy product.
Desktop FUSE layer is intentionally not unit tested — it is OS integration plumbing between the host OS and Rust SDK, covered instead by the Desktop E2E test suite.
Vault v1 legacy fields were removed when staging was reset; the current schema baseline (1700000000000-FullSchema.ts) was written after the reset and does not contain them.
Phase 37 implemented Web Worker encryption (encrypt-worker.service.ts, encrypt.worker.ts, encrypt.types.ts) and the `pin:secondaryFailed` event for batch upload secondary pin warning.
Linux FUSE mount is implemented (crates/fuse/src/platform/linux.rs), CTR streaming is in crates/fuse/src/operations.rs — both were incorrectly still listed as deferred.
Per-file IPNS conflict detection has been implemented via per-file IPNS metadata since Phase 12.6.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS env var provides user-configurable bin retention — was listed as deferred but already implemented.
Desktop app uses Rust FUSE directly, not the JS SDK — deferred items about desktop adopting new JS SDK exports were not applicable.
The batch upload pipeline (Phase 37) is implemented in JS SDK only; Rust SDK does not have batch upload support.
Integration tests in packages/sdk/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts require a live backend and are expected to fail in CI without one — 3 pre-existing failures are not regressions.

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker can throw without cleanup — fixed with try/catch that deletes pending entry on error to prevent map leak.
Doc comment for uploadFiles() overstated memory bounding — corrected to clarify actual behavior.

workflow: When asked to audit and prune a list, do every item systematically in one pass rather than only verifying items the user explicitly calls out — partial passes lead to repeated correction cycles.
Deferred item audits should run parallel codebase searches (grep for identifiers, check file existence) rather than relying on memory of what was implemented.
gh api GraphQL resolveReviewThread can batch multiple thread resolutions in a single call.
Use --field (not -f) for integer parameters like in_reply_to when posting PR review replies via REST.
DEFERRED.md should have an 'Implemented' section alongside the active deferred items so completed work can be tracked without being deleted.

friction: Initial DEFERRED.md audit was shallow — assistant only verified items the user explicitly flagged rather than doing a full systematic pass, requiring 4+ correction rounds.
Edit tool reformatted markdown table whitespace on the first DEFERRED.md edit, requiring a re-read and raw bash cat to see actual file content before subsequent edits.
Push to new docs branch required a retry (first push failed, likely missing --set-upstream).

The 'Already addressed' triage category for Copilot thread #3 (batch memory reads) required cross-referencing the deferred items context doc (37-CONTEXT.md) to confirm it was the same issue CodeRabbit had previously flagged.
open_items: Lazy file reading within concurrency pool (useDropUpload.ts) — requires SDK API change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array; tracked as deferred.
Batch upload not implemented in Rust SDK — only available in JS SDK.
Structured log query library / dashboard templates for Grafana Loki — deferred observability work.
SDK-level upload retry with exponential backoff — deferred upload pipeline hardening.
Chunked upload resume / partial retry on network interruption — deferred upload pipeline.
Cross-platform filesystem edge cases documented in FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md (5 documented gaps).
Desktop E2E test suite coverage for FUSE write operations — covered by existing Desktop E2E, but the spec of what scenarios are tested could be more explicit.
Security review findings tracked separately — were verified but details not surfaced in transcript.
PR #419 (docs update) needs review and merge.
